name: Dashboard Web

endpoints.description: Ringkasan KPI agregat Weighbridge/Grading/Cages Track untuk rentang tanggal & business unit terfilter

query_params.name: date_from
query_params.description: Filter tanggal awal; default hari ini jika tidak diisi

query_params.name: date_to
query_params.description: Filter tanggal akhir; default hari ini jika tidak diisi

query_params.name: business_unit_id
query_params.description: Filter business unit/mill; kosong berarti seluruh business unit

business_logic: 1. Validate query params: jika date_from > date_to, return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE
2. Default date_from/date_to ke hari ini jika tidak diisi
3. Query weighbridge-record WHERE business_unit_id matches (jika ada) AND record_datetime BETWEEN date_from/date_to -> hitung count dan SUM(net_weight)
4. Query grading-record dengan filter yang sama -> hitung count, SUM(netto), SUM(quantity)
5. Query cages-track-record dengan filter yang sama, JOIN cages-tipped-time -> hitung count cages-track-record dan SUM(total_cages) dari seluruh baris cages-tipped-time terkait

data_operations.description: Aggregate count + SUM(net_weight) dengan filter tanggal/business_unit
Aggregate count + SUM(netto) + SUM(quantity) dengan filter yang sama
Aggregate count dengan filter yang sama
JOIN ke cages-track-record dalam filter, SUM(total_cages) untuk total_cages_tipped

business_rules_applied: Filter tanggal default hari ini saat dashboard pertama dibuka
KPI dihitung dari data gabungan sync mobile + input web
Dashboard termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal

unit_test_cases.description: defaults date_from/date_to to today when not provided
unit_test_cases.expect: aggregation query runs with date range = today

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result with correct counts and sums when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: valid date range and business_unit_id; matching records exist

unit_test_cases.expect: aggregation queries scoped to WHERE business_unit_id = given value

unit_test_cases.description: returns zero counts/sums when no matching records exist
unit_test_cases.given: no records match the given filter
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with count=0 and all sums=0, not an error

unit_test_cases.description: aggregates cages_track total_cages_tipped across cages-tipped-time rows correctly
unit_test_cases.given: multiple cages-track-record rows in range, each with multiple cages-tipped-time rows
unit_test_cases.expect: total_cages_tipped = SUM(total_cages) across all cages-tipped-time rows belonging to in-range headers
